title: Cmd-K clears the focused terminal in its daemon, alone and inside a split, and the terminal shortcut audit's keys reach their owners
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with keyboard focus at its prompt
converted from scripts/cmux-next/terminal-keys-e2e.py (decision K1, cx-442), which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-097.json links them

steps.note: the scenario of scripts/cmux-next/terminal-keys-e2e.py (kept): Cmd-K in a terminal, then in each pane of a split, then the audit's keys

expect.noReceiptReason: plain keys go to the terminal's program; no cmux action runs for them

steps.note: the script's 400 numbered lines (`seq 1 400`), typed at the prompt; the terminals facet hashes the daemon's screen (read-screen), not the app's mirror

script row 'Cmd-K owner: action terminal.clear', then 'daemon screen cleared': terminal.clear sends the daemon's clear-history, so the daemon's own screen changes; on 7519459cdf0 (the parent of 4b5d8e0886f) only the app's Ghostty mirror was cleared and the daemon's screen kept the 400 lines
Split Right from a terminal: a new terminal pane beside it takes the focus (the person's Cmd-D, as the script's Cmd-Option-Right reaches the right pane)

expect.noReceiptReason: plain keys go to the terminal's program; no cmux action runs for them

steps.note: script row 'split terminal (right): daemon screen cleared': the focused pane of a split clears, the other pane's screen stays
script row 'terminal Cmd-[': focusHistoryBack runs in a terminal and moves the focus back to the left pane (cx-442, 7756faca26b); before it, Ghostty's goto_split took the key
script row 'terminal Cmd-]': focusHistoryForward returns to the right pane

script row 'terminal Cmd-C, nothing selected': terminalCopy runs and passes Cmd-C on to the program through Ghostty's performable copy binding (cx-442, 9176a6df4c7); Cmd-K above left nothing selected; on 12a75ec3cbe the action refused, so no action ran

expect.noReceiptReason: the audit's keys that belong to the program: no cmux action and no Ghostty binding (toggle_fullscreen, close_tab, close_all_windows) runs, so there is no receipt; the windows, layout and terminals facets after the step show nothing closed and no full screen

steps.note: script rows 'terminal Cmd-Return', 'terminal Cmd-Option-W', 'terminal Cmd-Option-Shift-W' and 'nothing closed' (cx-442, 12a75ec3cbe)

invariants: at cleared the focused terminal's last24Sha256 differs from filled's, and its daemon screen holds the prompt only, no numbered line
at cleared-right only the right pane's terminal changed from filled-right; the left pane's terminal keeps its hash
after history-back the focused pane is the left pane, after history-forward the right pane again
at end the windows facet lists one window, not full screen, the layout has the same two panes as cleared-right and the terminals list the same two terminals
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the script's daemon history check (`cmux terminal history read`): no facet reads a terminal's retained scrollback; the terminals facet hashes the screen's last 24 rows
the script's app viewport check (debug.surfaces text): the case reads the daemon's screen, the state a reattach shows
Cmd-K in an agent composer does nothing: the mock agent chat's composer key route is the agents suite's, and debug.key's reply (no action) is not compared for a step with no receipt
Cmd-=, Cmd-0, Cmd-Up, Cmd-Shift-G, Option-Left and the OWNER listing: the script prints their owner (handled_by, trace), which no facet records
keybinding.resolve outcomes for Cmd-Return and Cmd-[ (the script prints them)
